name: soloist-audio
description: Soloist low-latency audio engine (Oboe/AAudio on Android, AVAudioEngine on iOS, shared C++ core)

scripts.test:core: g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -pthread -Icpp cpp/*.cpp cpp/tests/core_test.cpp -o /tmp/soloist_core_test && /tmp/soloist_core_test && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -pthread -Icpp cpp/*.cpp cpp/tests/feature_test.cpp -o /tmp/soloist_feature_test && /tmp/soloist_feature_test
